page.overview:
Who is Elena Cho?

Ensign Elena Cho was a Starfleet officer in the 23rd century.

She and Nyota Uhura were Starfleet Academy roommates, occasionally hanging out together.

After graduation, she was assigned to the .

Cho died when the Cayuga was destroyed in 2260. ()
